FINDINGS NEEDING OWNER DECISION (not fixed, no separate items filed yet):
(a) 1_v8 ORDER_DIFFERS in all 5 executions: the QUALIFY elimination renders SELECT ... FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ..., COUNT(*) OVER (...) AS _w FROM lineitem WHERE ... ORDER BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus) AS _t WHERE _w > 0; the ORDER BY is inside the derived table and the outer query has none, so output order is undefined and PrestoDB returns N/F before A/F. Rendering verified independently. Suspected rule: the fork's QUALIFY elimination for the Presto generator should hoist the ORDER BY; 1_v8 is the only rendered query with that pattern. Likely also affects Trino and Athena (same family; not run).
(b) 15_v1, 15_v4, 15_v7, 15_v10 returned 0 rows against 1 on the first run; canonical Q15 also returns a row in only 9 of 20 further executions. Cause: Q15 selects the max-revenue supplier with = between two independently summed DOUBLE values; summation order varies run to run (inferred, not traced). BenchBox's DuckDB schema uses DECIMAL where the equality is exact; not exercised here. A single Presto execution of Q15 or its variants is not evidence either way.
(c) 1_v7 memory on PrestoDB: HashAggregationOperator (SINGLE;ORDER_BY;); about 1.9 GiB per scale factor, 2.4x the Trino figure. Default limits (-Xmx6G, query.max-memory-per-node 614.4 MB = 10% of heap): FAIL EXCEEDED_LOCAL_MEMORY_LIMIT at SF1, SF2 and SF3.
